g.title: MAVEN_A_CABIN
g.text: Maven / Deutsch HD30 shell-size-24 16-way flange receptacle
Cabin side — permanent from Phase 2b install onward. Sockets, size-16 contacts.
CAN H (to Gauge.S cluster CAN input)
CAN L (to Gauge.S cluster CAN input)
DCT shifter UP (paddle Black wire → MaxxECU DIN 2)
DCT shifter DOWN (paddle Blue wire → MaxxECU DIN 1)
DCT shifter GND (paddle Brown wire → MaxxECU SGND)
SPARE — reserved as cabin sensor +5V rail
SPARE — reserved as cabin sensor GND rail

Connector A carries Phase 1/2 signals — CAN to Gauge.S cluster and DCT shifter paddle inputs. Both signal sets are active from Phase 1 (via OEM grommet as individual wires until Phase 2b Maven install re-terminates them here).

CAN TOPOLOGY (pins 1/2/3): twisted differential pair with shield per ISO 11898-2:2016. Shield drain terminates at the ECU end only (single-end drain — prevents ground loops). 120Ω termination at MaxxECU C1 (internal) and at the far end of the cabin CAN bus (Gauge.S or the physically-last CAN node).

DCT SHIFTER (pins 4/5/6): passive momentary switches per dctshifter.com/pages/installation. No +12V supply — the paddle closes UP or DOWN to GND. Pin 6 is the shared GND reference to MaxxECU 16-pin aux breakout pin 2 (Sensor GND). See harnesses/dct-shifter.wv.
SPARE PIN STRATEGY (pins 7-16): pins 7 and 8 pre-reserved for future +5V/SGND rails if additional cabin analog sensors are added. Remaining 8 positions cavity-plugged.

g.title: W_MAVEN_A
g.text: MAVEN_A_CABIN:1:CAN H (to Gauge.S cluster CAN input)
MAVEN_A_ENGINE:1:CAN H → MaxxECU C1 E1 (CMC CAN H)
MAVEN_A_CABIN:2:CAN L (to Gauge.S cluster CAN input)
MAVEN_A_ENGINE:2:CAN L → MaxxECU C1 E2 (CMC CAN L)
MAVEN_A_ENGINE:3:Shield drain → MaxxECU C1 H1 SGND (or backshell tie)
MAVEN_A_CABIN:4:DCT shifter UP (paddle Black wire → MaxxECU DIN 2)
MAVEN_A_CABIN:5:DCT shifter DOWN (paddle Blue wire → MaxxECU DIN 1)
MAVEN_A_CABIN:6:DCT shifter GND (paddle Brown wire → MaxxECU SGND)
Length is a placeholder — measure from the cabin-side Gauge.S cluster and DCT paddle through the firewall to the Maven Connector A mating face at Phase 2b install.

SHIELD: CAN pair (wires 1/2) inside a foil shield with drain (wire 3). Terminate the drain only at the ECU end (engine bay). DCT wires (4/5/6) can share the outer jacket but do not need to be inside the CAN shield foil — they are low-frequency low-current switch signals and are not noise-critical.

g.title: MAVEN_A_ENGINE
g.text: Maven / Deutsch HD30 shell-size-24 16-way jam-nut plug
Engine side — installed at Phase 3b with 07K harness. Pins, size-16 contacts.
CAN H → MaxxECU C1 E1 (CMC CAN H)
CAN L → MaxxECU C1 E2 (CMC CAN L)
Shield drain → MaxxECU C1 H1 SGND (or backshell tie)
SPARE — reserved for cabin sensor +5V (from MaxxECU G1)
SPARE — reserved for cabin sensor SGND (from MaxxECU H1)
Mates MAVEN_A_CABIN via 1/4-turn coupling ring. Destination pins reference MaxxECU RACE C1 (48-pin) per docs/vendor/maxxecu/MaxxECU_GEN1_Pinout.md and the RACE REV9+ wiring PDF.

g.title: MAVEN_B_CABIN
g.text: Maven / Deutsch HD30 shell-size-24 16-way flange receptacle
Cabin side — permanent from Phase 2b install; populated Phase 3b. Sockets, size-16 contacts.

All 16 positions CAVITY-PLUGGED during Phase 2b install. Populated at Phase 3b when the E46 APS pedal module is installed. Two INDEPENDENT REDUNDANT CHANNELS — do NOT bridge SGND1↔SGND2 or +5V1↔+5V2 at any point; the redundancy is what enables MaxxECU E-Throttle to fault-detect a channel failure. See docs/dbw-pinouts.md for E46 APS pinout confirmation.
TWISTING: APS ch1 (SGND1 + VCC1 = pins 1 and 2) as one pair; APS ch2 (SGND2 + VCC2 = pins 4 and 5) as a second pair. Preserves the +5V-to-SGND reference topology per channel.
SIGNAL WIRES (pins 3, 6): single-ended 0.5-4.5V ratiometric; not paired but still shielded as part of the overall cable bundle.
10 spare cavities remaining after APS install (pins 7-16). Sized for future expansion.

g.title: W_MAVEN_B
g.text: MAVEN_B_ENGINE:2:APS +5V 1 → MaxxECU C1 G1 (+5V sensor rail)
MAVEN_B_ENGINE:3:APS1 signal → MaxxECU C2 APS1 AIN
MAVEN_B_ENGINE:5:APS +5V 2 → MaxxECU C1 G1 (+5V sensor rail)
MAVEN_B_ENGINE:6:APS2 signal → MaxxECU C2 APS2 AIN
Length is a placeholder — measure from the driver footwell E46 APS pedal module through the firewall to the Maven Connector B mating face at Phase 3b install.
TWISTING: twist SGND1+VCC1 (wires 1 and 2) as one pair; SGND2+VCC2 (wires 4 and 5) as a second pair. Signal wires (3 and 6) are single-ended.

All 6 wires inside the same overall foil shield along with the W_MAVEN_A CAN pair if the two Maven connectors are physically adjacent on the same plate (which they are). Drain terminates once at the ECU end via W_MAVEN_A wire 3.

g.title: MAVEN_B_ENGINE
g.text: Maven / Deutsch HD30 shell-size-24 16-way jam-nut plug
Engine side — installed at Phase 3b with 07K harness. Pins, size-16 contacts.
APS +5V 1 → MaxxECU C1 G1 (+5V sensor rail)
APS1 signal → MaxxECU C2 APS1 AIN
APS +5V 2 → MaxxECU C1 G1 (+5V sensor rail)
APS2 signal → MaxxECU C2 APS2 AIN

Mates MAVEN_B_CABIN via 1/4-turn coupling ring. Verify MaxxECU C2 APS1/APS2 physical pin numbers against the RACE REV9+ wiring diagram at build time (also captured in harnesses/maxxecu-07k.wv APS block).
